gpu_choice: NVIDIA L4 (Ada, 3rd-gen RT cores, 24 GB). Isaac Sim 6.x requirements: RT cores required (A100/H100 unsupported), >= 16 GB VRAM; tested tiers RTX 4080 / 5080 / RTX PRO 6000. L4 meets the RT-core and VRAM requirements but is not a tested tier, so sufficiency is measured (startup, render validity, real-time factor, VRAM) in the first session rather than assumed. RTX PRO 6000 (G4) is offered in us-central1-b/c/f but this project has no G4 GPU quota; L4 quota is 8.

cost.note: Asia-Southeast1 L4 rates checked 28 Oct 2026 against the existing DREAM G2 runtime-builder configuration. 50 GiB NAT reserve covers Isaac Sim 6.2 wheels, PyTorch, the 8.9 GiB Qwen checkpoint and streamed NVIDIA assets. Estimate, not a billing cap.

cap_note: US Central had no L4 capacity in any approved zone on 28 Oct 2026. Switched to DREAM's already priced Asia-Southeast1 L4 region; the session ceiling tracks the resulting 180-minute estimate with modest headroom. The continuation guard remains US$100.
